method: Visual inspection of actual rendered skinned model in frame-by-frame contact pages and selected full-resolution frames. Numbers were not used as visual approval. GIF timing and endpoint handling were separately inspected.

inspected.UnityOtherClipAuxiliaryViews: 8 key poses in Front/Opposite/Back per clip
inspected.connections: all six raw endpoints and frames around 0.12 second preview blends
inspected.sourceBlender: selected final four-view attack key poses and static same-scale protagonist comparison; final complete comparison GIF packaging remains root responsibility

resolved_findings: Initial weapon shaft used wrong accessory axis; final corrected weapon rises vertically then chops forward, with grip aligned in real skinned model.
Initial synchronous Unity capture kept skinned pose cached while weapon moved. Final captures force per-render matrix recalculation and visibly move head, torso, pelvis and arms coherently.
Constant Move and Attack root-height corrections remove obvious below-ground toe penetration at intended Y=0 marks.
Source timing is 30fps; corrected combat Idle clip is present. GIF playback omits inclusive duplicate terminal sample while PNG contacts retain it.

visual_findings.attack: Preparation approx0-0.53s, rapid strike approx0.53-0.67s and recovery through1.067s are distinguishable in both side directions. Torso/head/hip changes accompany arm motion. No visible reverse elbows, wrist flip, grip separation or shoulder/cloak collapse in inspected final frames.
visual_findings.idle: Foot positions remain visually stable and sway changes continuously through the loop.
visual_findings.move: Bouncy native run with alternating legs, brief toe support and airborne phases; no abrupt loop pose jump observed. Ground markers, rather than lowered opaque floor, were used for contact review.
visual_findings.hit: Short subtle upper-body response returns coherently; no visible mesh explosion or pose discontinuity.
visual_findings.connections: Raw clip endpoints differ, especially movement to attack. The isolated0.12s blends showed no visible limb inversion or grip break; these are preview-only transitions.

minor_limits: Large head partly hides the far weapon hand during opposite-side preparation; blade tip and front chopping arc remain readable.
Run is intentionally bouncy and support is brief; game travel-speed matching, terrain foot locking and stopping behavior have not been tested.
Unity atlas preview cloak is very dark; actual scene lighting and material readability need integration review.
No gameplay Animator transitions, hitboxes, VFX, root travel or controller behavior were changed/tested.
No humanoid retarget claim is made; this is native Generic rig reuse.
Human real-time viewing at preferred playback speed remains user feedback; review used every sampled frame and verified1x/0.5x timing rather than claiming live playback perception.
